title: THE MOONSHINE RUN
heading: COPPERHEAD RIDGE
THE MOONSHINE RUN
intro: LOAD GRANNY'S SHINE, CUT THE REVENUE RADIO AND RING THE CHURCH BELL.
ending: "GRANNY SAYS THE TAX IS PAID IN FULL."

stations.label: LOAD GRANNY'S SHINE
stations.message: TWENTY JARS OF TRIPLE-X IN THE TRUNK. THE BARN DOORS ARE OPEN. DRIVE SOFT.

stations.label: RING THE CHURCH BELL
stations.message: THE BELL CARRIES UP THE RIDGE. COUSIN DEWEY'S PULLIN' THE LOG GATE.

stations.label: CUT THE REVENUE RADIO
stations.message: RADIO'S DEAD. THEM CRUISERS CAN'T CALL YOU IN NO MORE.

stations.label: BANG ON THE STILL CAVE DOOR
stations.message: REVENUE MAN: COME ON IN, SON. BRING THE EVIDENCE.

notes: LOAD'S IN THE BARN. REVENUE MAN TOOK MY STILL UP THE RIDGE. RING THE BELL FOR DEWEY.
U.S. REVENUE. PAID TO S. PRUITT: $40 FOR INFO ON H. STILL. KEEP YOUR MOUTH SHUT.
H. STILL SEIZED. 300 GAL. EVIDENCE. HOLD TILL DAWN THEN DESTROY. DO NOT TASTE IT, PRUITT.

lines: RADIO: CAR TWO, ANY SIGN OF THAT LOAD?
AGENT: CHIEF SAYS DON'T TASTE THE EVIDENCE.

do.message: GRANNY'S LOAD. THE KEYS ARE IN THE STOCK CAR.
THE BLACKTOP. MIND THE CRUISERS, THEY DON'T BRAKE.
SNAKE HOLLER. SKEETER PRUITT LIVES DOWN HERE.
GRANNY'S BARN KEY. SKEETER SOLD HER OUT. TACK ROOM'S HERS AGAIN.
THE REVENUE CAMP. THE STILL'S IN THE CAVE BEHIND IT.

lap_cars.dry: THE CRUISERS LOST THEIR RADIO. THEY'RE PULLIN' OVER.

vehicle_lines.car: GRANNY'S RUNNER'S GOT THE KEYS IN IT. LOAD HER UP.

vehicle_runs.title: THE MOONSHINE RUN
vehicle_runs.intro: THE MOONSHINE RUN! GET GRANNY'S LOAD PAST THE REVENUERS!
vehicle_runs.won: PAST THE COUNTY LINE IN %s! GRANNY'S TIP IS IN THE GLOVEBOX.
vehicle_runs.lost: THE REVENUERS RADIOED AHEAD. TRY IT AGAIN.
